corrections.notes:
For the 120° Curved Peak Lapel shown in the illustration, the peak is extremely open and the outer lapel edge incorporates a gentle curve rather than a straight line. This is one of the most dramatic peak-lapel geometries used in bespoke tailoring.

Visual Analysis of the Image

The image contains:

A peak lapel with a marked gorge angle of 120°
A pronounced sweeping lapel shape
A curved outer lapel edge
A long spear-point lapel ending near the waist button position
A relatively wide chest opening
A small breast welt pocket indication on the wearer's left side

Tailoring Interpretation

A 120° Curved Peak Lapel creates:

Maximum shoulder-emphasis effect
Very broad chest appearance
Long sweeping lapel line
Strong vintage 1930s and theatrical bespoke influence
A shape halfway between a dramatic peak lapel and a swept shawl lapel
